---

Every button below opens a modal built by the extension as this page was rendered.

This site sets two defaults for all of them, in `_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
extensions:
  modal:
    fade: true
    centred: true
```

Individual modals below override those.

## A modal with a footer

The first heading becomes the title, and a horizontal rule separates the footer from the body.

````markdown
{{{< modal toggle target=modal-basic label="Open the basic modal" >}}}

::: {#modal-basic}
## A basic modal

The body, written as ordinary markdown, so a [link](https://quarto.org) or a
list works as it would anywhere else.

---

{{{< modal dismiss inside=true label="Close" >}}}
:::
````

{{< modal toggle target=modal-basic label="Open the basic modal" >}}

::: {#modal-basic}
## A basic modal

The body, written as ordinary markdown, so a [link](https://quarto.org) or a list works as it would anywhere else.

---

{{< modal dismiss inside=true label="Close" >}}
:::

The dismiss button sits inside the modal it closes, so it uses `inside=true` rather than naming a target.

## Sizes

`size` takes the Bootstrap tokens or the friendly aliases.

{{< modal toggle target=modal-small label="Small" classes="btn btn-outline-primary" >}}
{{< modal toggle target=modal-large label="Large" classes="btn btn-outline-primary" >}}
{{< modal toggle target=modal-xl label="Extra large" classes="btn btn-outline-primary" >}}

::: {#modal-small size=small}
## Small

`size=small`, which resolves to the Bootstrap `sm` token.

---

{{< modal dismiss inside=true label="Close" >}}
:::

::: {#modal-large size=lg}
## Large

`size=lg`.

---

{{< modal dismiss inside=true label="Close" >}}
:::

::: {#modal-xl size=extra-large}
## Extra large

`size=extra-large`, which resolves to `xl`.

---

{{< modal dismiss inside=true label="Close" >}}
:::

```markdown
::: {#modal-small size=small}
::: {#modal-large size=lg}
::: {#modal-xl size=extra-large}
```

## Scrolling, fullscreen, and a static backdrop

{{< modal toggle target=modal-scrollable label="Scrollable" classes="btn btn-outline-primary" >}}
{{< modal toggle target=modal-fullscreen label="Fullscreen below lg" classes="btn btn-outline-primary" >}}
{{< modal toggle target=modal-static label="Static backdrop" classes="btn btn-outline-primary" >}}

::: {#modal-scrollable scrollable=true}
## Scrollable

The body scrolls rather than the page behind it.

{{< lipsum 3 >}}

---

{{< modal dismiss inside=true label="Close" >}}
:::

::: {#modal-fullscreen fullscreen=lg}
## Fullscreen below a breakpoint

`fullscreen=lg` fills the screen on anything narrower than the large breakpoint, and behaves normally above it.

---

{{< modal dismiss inside=true label="Close" >}}
:::

::: {#modal-static backdrop-static=true keyboard=false}
## Static backdrop

`backdrop-static=true` keeps this open when the backdrop is clicked, and `keyboard=false` stops <kbd>Esc</kbd> from closing it.
The close button is the way out.

---

{{< modal dismiss inside=true label="Close" >}}
:::

```markdown
::: {#modal-scrollable scrollable=true}
::: {#modal-fullscreen fullscreen=lg}
::: {#modal-static backdrop-static=true keyboard=false}
```

## Opening a modal from a link

A link whose target is a modal identifier is expanded into a toggle, so a modal can be opened from the middle of a sentence, [like this one](#modal-basic).

```markdown
[like this one](#modal-basic)
```

The explicit Bootstrap attributes work too, when a link would be the wrong element:

```markdown
[Open it]{bs-target="#modal-basic" bs-toggle="modal"}
```

## Accessibility

`description` points at the identifier of an element elsewhere on the page, and becomes the modal's `aria-describedby`.

{{< modal toggle target=modal-described label="Described modal" classes="btn btn-outline-primary" >}}

::: {#modal-described description="described-note" close-button-label="Dismiss this dialog"}
## A described modal

`close-button-label` renames the header's close button for screen readers.

---

{{< modal dismiss inside=true label="Close" >}}
:::

[This paragraph carries the identifier the modal points at.]{#described-note}

```markdown
::: {#modal-described description="described-note" close-button-label="Dismiss this dialog"}
```

The identifier has to exist in the document; the extension warns when it does not, since a dangling `aria-describedby` is worse than none.
